summary.content:
Today's selection covers 78 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 58 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: U.S. Says Anthropic Is an ‘Unacceptable’ National Security Risk
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: More Attackers Are Logging In, Not Breaking In
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, TechCrunch, The Verge, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 46 articles published in the last 24 hours
